Title: Purity of the beast and ally in torpor question

Messages.Author: Chris Arthur
Messages.Body:
Forgive me if the answer is obvious but what happens if a vampire
attempts to enter combat with an ally in torpor using purity of the
beast? Does combat occur? I assume not because only ready minions can
be involved in a combat.

Purity of the Beast [AH, FN]
Cardtype: Action
Requires a ready vampire. +1 stealth action.
(D) Enter combat with an ally controlled by your prey. The acting
vampire gets +2 strength for the duration of this combat.

Chris.

Messages.Author: LSJ
Messages.Body:
Chris Arthur wrote:
>
> Forgive me if the answer is obvious but what happens if a vampire
> attempts to enter combat with an ally in torpor using purity of the
> beast? Does combat occur? I assume not because only ready minions can
> be involved in a combat.

Correct - in fact, PoB cannot be played in this case - that is, you
cannot play it on an invalid target and have the action fizzle just
to get the card out of your hand.

Likewise a vampire in torpor with Haven Uncovered cannot be attacked,
either.
